currencies.name: Solars
currencies.description: The common coin of the realm. Used for most trade and services.

currencies.name: Gems
currencies.description: Rare premium currency. Obtained through special events and achievements. Cannot be traded.

currencies.name: Monds
currencies.description: The only currency a character can be bought with. Sold for Naira in packs, never earned in play, never traded. Gems spin for a character, Monds buy one outright.

currencies.name: Bank Gold
currencies.description: Solars deposited in the Royal Bank. Earns interest over time. Not directly spendable until withdrawn.

currencies.name: Loan
currencies.description: Outstanding debt owed to the Royal Bank or a moneylender. Accrues interest if unpaid. A negative balance here is bad.
